primitives.name: Cloud Fallback Sequence

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'O_{\\text{cloud}}': 'ordered set of cloud providers {bedrock, azure, vertex}', 'P_{\\text{primary}}': 'selected primary provider', 'F_{\\text{failover}}': 'boolean flag for enabled failover'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: All clouds exhausted without success triggers Anthropic cash fallback.

primitives.name: Credit Pool Allocation
primitives.verbatim_quote: modelName → credit pool ← credit-pool.ts ``` **Nothing pulls opposite:** free-lane never blocks clouds; clouds failover
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M_{\\text{model}}': 'model identifier string', 'P_{\\text{pool}}': 'credit pool name {aws_activate, azure_foundry, ...}', 'C_{\\text{cost}}': 'cost in USD per token'}
primitives.assumptions: Each model maps deterministically to a credit pool; cost is tracked per token.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Model selection fails if no valid credit pool exists for given model.

layer2.mapping: Associates model identifiers with credit pools using Jynx's internal credit-pool.ts logic.
layer2.telemetry: Logs model → pool mapping in usage ledger under creditStack.jynx
